title: Great quality lunch bag for all ages!
text: Great quality lunch bag for all ages!. Super cute and colorful, this is a great insulated lunch bag. Lots of room for a can of soda, sandwich and salad, this bag can be used by young and old alike, male or female. Quality made, solid zipper, this bag will last for years. I also love the shoulder strap which makes it easy for me to bring with me (especially when I have a purse and a laptop to carry). Highly recommend this bag for everyone (and it comes in several colors, I have blue and it's beautiful and easy to find if I put it in the office refrigerator).

product_metadata.title: ADOLPH Insulated Leakproof Lunch Bag with Adjustable Shoulder Strap for Women Men - Wide Open Reusable Cooler Bag for Office Work School Picnic Beach-Pink
features: 【Leakproof & Thermal Insulated】 For greater thermal insulation, the interior lining is made from PEVA foil and padded with 6mm EPE foam, that’s is soft and insulated, to keep food stay cold/warm/fresh for hours.The upgraded heat-welded seams technology also makes its main compartment 100% leakproof for much more convenient use.

【Convenient Wide Open Design】 The top of ADOLPH lunch bag opens up to 10.5" x 6.8"(L x W), which allows you easily and quickly put in or take out lunch box horizontally, prevents liquids leaking or spilling out. Wide open design is for easy access and cleaning to get rid of the hassle to find any small items and largely save your time.

【Spacious & Multi Compartment】This lunch box features one main zipped compartment (10 x 6.7 x 8 inch) to pack all of food and snacks you need whole day. One deep zipped front pocket and extra back pocket to contain your utensils, keys, phone chargers and more small essential items. Two mesh side pockets for you to put water bottle,umbrella or napkins, etc..

【Durable Construction】The exterior of ADOLPH cooler bag is constructed from high density water-resistant and dirt-proof Oxford cloth for maximum durability and easy cleaning. Premium reinforced metal SBS dual zippers, secure zippers closure and metal buckles ensure smooth open and close.

【Portable & Versatile】Designed with a padded handle and a detachable shoulder strap that offers multiple carrying styles and allows for effortless carrying. Stylish design make it can be used in many occasions as you prefer, perfect for school office and picnic; suitable for women men.
